bibliographic.title: IQ
bibliographic.author: Miraj
bibliographic.description:
As a player, you begin to hear voices at the start of your morning walk and wonder if Nature is communicating with you, as the game progresses there are more voices...in the end when you return home satisfied gaining a wider perspective of Life, you're in for an amusing surprise.


EDIT: This is my first attempt at making a game, I have no coding skills, so the gameplay is too much simple, which justifies my forgiveness rating to "Merciful". lol.

Hope you enjoy it.
